title: The hypertrophy series: using pyramids, drop sets and finishers for muscle growth
summary: NH gives his view on pyramids, drop sets and finishers versus straight sets. Captions are unusable machine-translated junk, so this note relies on the title and description: set type directly affects progression and the accumulation of quality tonnage, so these methods must be judged carefully.
claims: The type of sets you use (straight sets, pyramids, drop sets, finishers) directly affects progression and quality tonnage accumulation
Methods that diverge from straight sets should be assessed cautiously before being added to a program
